text: Love the concept but the pricing is insane. $20/month per seat for a scheduling tool? My team of 5 would cost $100/month just for booking links.
Works well but notifications are spammy. I get 3 emails for every booking. No way to customize what I get notified about.
The app crashes when I try to connect Google Calendar. Support has not responded in 2 weeks. Very frustrating.
Switched from Calendly because of the per-seat pricing. If you're a small team it adds up fast. Looking for flat-rate alternatives.
The new redesign made the booking flow slower. Used to be 3 clicks, now it's 7. Why do companies keep doing this?
Charged me after I cancelled. No refund, no response to emails. This feels like a scam.
Missing basic features like team round-robin and embeddable booking pages. Had to build workarounds.
Great app but would love dark mode and the ability to customize the booking page branding. Also needs offline mode for mobile.
